subject: Taxes
title: France's Yellow Vest Movement
description: A 60-second lesson on France's Yellow Vest Movement.

hook.text: In November 2018, French citizens in yellow vests blocked roads and burned cars.

buildup.text: President Macron raised diesel taxes to fight climate change.

discovery.text: Protesters saw hypocrisy: the government cut wealth taxes for the rich, then raised fuel taxes on the working class.

twist.text: Macron canceled the tax and offered €10 billion in concessions.

climax.text: The Yellow Vests showed that climate taxes fail unless they're perceived as fair across all income levels.

punchline.text: Tax diesel, cut wealth tax. The math didn't add up. Streets burned.

quiz.question: What triggered France's Yellow Vest protests?
